# Menu bar (`menu-bar`)

Desktop menu bar with submenus and shortcuts.

Group: Navigation. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/navigation';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createMenuBar` (types in `dist/web/navigation/menuBar.d.ts`): `.mh-menu-bar` (`role="menubar"`): `.mh-menu-bar__menu`s, each a `button.mh-menu-bar__trigger` (`role="menuitem"`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, roving `tabindex`) and a `.mh-menu-bar__popup` (`role="menu"`) of `.mh-menu-bar__item`s (`menuitem`, or `menuitemcheckbox` with `aria-checked`; `--danger`, `--submenu` with a nested `__popup--sub`), `__separator`s, leading `__lead` (icon or check), `__label` and `__shortcut`. Keyboard: Left / Right across the bar (an open menu follows), Down / Up / Enter / Space open, arrows, Home, End and typing a letter move inside, Right / Left enter and leave submenus, Escape closes one level, Tab closes all. Pointer: click opens, hovering moves between open menus and opens submenus. Pass `root` to build into an existing element (the React binding does).

```ts
export function createMenuBar(options: MenuBarOptions, root?: HTMLElement): MenuBarHandle;

export interface MenuBarOptions {
  menus: readonly MenuBarMenu[];
  /** Accessible name of the bar ("Editor"). */
  label?: string;
  /** An item was chosen; for a checkable one, `checked` is its new state. */
  onSelect?: (value: string, checked?: boolean) => void;
}

export interface MenuBarHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** Closes any open menu. */
  close(): void;
  setChecked(value: string, checked: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(value: string, disabled: boolean): void;
  /** Removes the document listeners (and the content, when built into an existing element). */
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createMenuBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = document.createElement('p');
const menuBar = createMenuBar({
  label: 'Floor plan editor',
  menus: [
    {
      label: 'File',
      items: [
        { value: 'new', label: 'New plan', shortcut: 'Ctrl+N' },
        { value: 'save', label: 'Save', shortcut: 'Ctrl+S' },
        { separator: true },
        { value: 'delete', label: 'Delete plan', danger: true },
      ],
    },
    { label: 'Edit', items: [{ value: 'undo', label: 'Undo', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Z' }, { value: 'redo', label: 'Redo' }] },
    { label: 'View', items: [{ value: 'grid', label: 'Show grid', checked: true }] },
  ],
  // For a checkable item, `checked` is its new state.
  onSelect: (value, checked) => (status.textContent = checked === undefined ? value : `${value}: ${checked}`),
});

document.body.append(menuBar.el, status);
```

## React API

`MenuBar` (types in `dist/react/navigation.d.ts`): `createMenuBar` built into the rendered element: same DOM, classes and keyboard behaviour.

```ts
export function MenuBar({ menus, label, onSelect, className }: MenuBarProps);

export interface MenuBarProps {
  /** Rebuilt when this changes identity: keep it in state or a memo. */
  menus: readonly MenuBarMenu[];
  label?: string;
  onSelect?: (value: string, checked?: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { MenuBar } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { MenuBarMenu } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Defined once: the menu bar rebuilds whenever `menus` changes.
const MENUS: MenuBarMenu[] = [
  {
    label: 'File',
    items: [
      { value: 'new', label: 'New plan', shortcut: 'Ctrl+N' },
      { value: 'save', label: 'Save', shortcut: 'Ctrl+S' },
      { separator: true },
      { value: 'delete', label: 'Delete plan', danger: true },
    ],
  },
  { label: 'Edit', items: [{ value: 'undo', label: 'Undo', shortcut: 'Ctrl+Z' }, { value: 'redo', label: 'Redo' }] },
  { label: 'View', items: [{ value: 'grid', label: 'Show grid', checked: true }] },
];

export function MenuBarExample() {
  const [grid, setGrid] = useState(true);
  const select = (value: string, checked?: boolean) => {
    if (value === 'grid') setGrid(Boolean(checked));
  };
  return (
    <div>
      <MenuBar label="Floor plan editor" menus={MENUS} onSelect={select} />
      <p>Grid {grid ? 'shown' : 'hidden'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
